description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Cassiopeia''' spews forth 7 bolts of venom in an arc at the target location, creating toxic clouds at the area for 5 seconds.
description.text: Active: Cassiopeia spews forth 7 bolts of venom in an arc at the target location, creating toxic clouds at the area for 5 seconds.

description2.raw: Enemies within the clouds are [[File:Poison icon.png|20px|link=Cassiopeia/LoL|An icon representing the keyword Poison]] [[:Cassiopeia/LoL|poisoned]] to take magic damage every 0.263 seconds and become [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounded]] and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by an amount that decays over the area's duration.
description2.text: Enemies within the clouds are poisoned to take magic damage every 0.263 seconds and become grounded and slowed by an amount that decays over the area's duration.

notes.raw: * ''Miasma's'' [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] and [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|ground]] debuffs are each marked as non-dispellable, so they are not removed by most [[File:Remove Scurvy.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Removal|An icon representing the keyword Cleanse]] [[:Crowd control#Removal|cleanses]]. Each is however allowed to be removed by cleanses that '''also''' grant immunity to the debuff type, such as [[File:Olaf OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Olaf|An icon representing Olaf]] [[Olaf|Olaf's]] [[File:Olaf Ragnarok.png|20xpx|border|link=Olaf#Ragnarok|An icon for Olaf's ability Ragnarok]] [[Olaf#Ragnarok|Ragnarok]]. * If a target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] while affected by the [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|ground]], the debuff will refresh to 0.25 seconds. * [[File:Yasuo Wind Wall.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Wind Wall|An icon for Yasuo's ability Wind Wall]] [[Yasuo#Wind Wall|Wind Wall]] will block the portion of ''Miasma'' it destroys. * ''Miasma'' inflicts 5 / 6.25 / 7.5 / 8.75 / 10 (+ 2.5% AP) magic damage per tick, and in fact because there is 19 ticks and not 20 ticks, the '''total''' magic damage is currently not 100 / 125 / 150 / 175 / 200 (+ 50% AP) but 95 / 118.75 / 142.5 / 166.25 / 190 (+ 47.5% AP). ** Sometimes ''Miasma'' randomly inflicts only 18 ticks of damage.(bug)
notes.text:
Miasma's slow and ground debuffs are each marked as non-dispellable, so they are not removed by most cleanses. Each is however allowed to be removed by cleanses that also grant immunity to the debuff type, such as Olaf's Ragnarok.
If a target becomes untargetable while affected by the ground, the debuff will refresh to 0.25 seconds.
Wind Wall will block the portion of Miasma it destroys.
Miasma inflicts 5 / 6.25 / 7.5 / 8.75 / 10 (+ 2.5% AP) magic damage per tick, and in fact because there is 19 ticks and not 20 ticks, the total magic damage is currently not 100 / 125 / 150 / 175 / 200 (+ 50% AP) but 95 / 118.75 / 142.5 / 166.25 / 190 (+ 47.5% AP).
* Sometimes Miasma randomly inflicts only 18 ticks of damage.(bug)
